label: preparing
what: Innkeeper and tradespeople are jointly preparing an eighteen-o'clock great-hall meeting and presentation, including substantial bread provision. Freight is arranging grain financing, baker will bake, and builder supplies collateral; secretary coordinates scheduling and approval, while I have agreed to finance against security. Their full purpose has not been disclosed to me. A surprise marking my forty years of service is plausible but remains speculation, not established fact.
